name: Puzzle
definition: Logic and pattern games solved one problem at a time, covering matching, sorting, words, physics and riddles. Short sessions, low commitment.
local_terms: CN: 解谜 (jiěmí), with 益智 (yìzhì) for brain-training puzzles. KR: 퍼즐 (peojeul). JP: パズル (pazuru).
subgenres: Match Swap, Match Pair, Sort, Riddle, Word, Physics, Block, Match Merge, Trivia

name: Simulation
definition: Games that model a system to build, manage or inhabit, covering creative sandboxes, light tycoon and management, idle loops and life sims.
local_terms: CN: 模拟经营 (mónǐ jīngyíng) for the management strain. KR: 시뮬레이션 (simyulleisyeon). JP: シミュレーション (shimyurēshon), but see the JP note on Strategy.
subgenres: Sandbox, Simulator, Idler, Tycoon/Crafting, Driving/Flight

name: Arcade
definition: Fast, reflex-driven single-session games with simple controls, covering endless runners, rhythm and casual action.
local_terms: KR: 아케이드 (akeideu). CN: 休闲 (xiūxián), casual, covers much of the same ground. The JP App Store has no Arcade category either.
subgenres: Platformer/Runner, Other Arcade, Music/Rhythm, Arcade Combat

name: RPG
definition: Character progression, collection and persistent advancement, usually gacha-monetised on mobile.
local_terms: CN: 角色扮演 (juésè bànyǎn). KR: 롤플레잉 (rolpeulleing). JP: ロールプレイング (rōrupureingu). JP trade press often writes ソーシャルゲーム (sōsharu gēmu) or スマホゲーム (sumaho gēmu) for the segment.
subgenres: Idle RPG, MMORPG, Squad RPG, Puzzle RPG, Turn-based RPG, Open-World Adventure

name: Strategy
definition: Planning, resource management and competition, covering base-building, real-time tactics, 4X empire, tower defense and card battlers.
local_terms: CN: 策略 (cèlüè), with 塔防 (tǎfáng) for tower defense. KR: 전략 (jeollyak). JP: ストラテジー (sutoratejī), though JP usage often files turn-based strategy under シミュレーション as SLG.
subgenres: MOBA, 4X, RTS, Build & Battle, Tower Defense, Card Battler

name: Casino
definition: Social-casino and chance-based games, covering slots, poker, bingo, coin-pusher, dice and board formats, and mahjong. Gambling-adjacent with no real-money payout.
local_terms: CN: 棋牌 (qípái), the board-and-card category where CN gambling-adjacent play files. KR: 카지노 (kajino). JP: カジノ (kajino).
subgenres: Slots, Coin-pusher, Mahjong, social casino

name: Lifestyle
definition: Expressive, identity and care-oriented play, covering avatar and character customisation, dress-up, home design and virtual pets.
subgenres: Customization, Virtual Pet

name: Tabletop
definition: Digital versions of classic table and card games, covering solitaire, chess, board games and coloring. Includes culturally specific variants such as Korea's 고스톱 (Go-Stop) and 맞고 (Matgo).
local_terms: CN: 桌游 (zhuōyóu), often paired as 棋牌桌游. KR: 보드 (bodeu) and 카드 (kadeu), plus 맞고 (Matgo). JP: ボード (bōdo) and カード (kādo).
subgenres: Solitaire, Board, Drawing & Coloring

name: Sports
definition: Realistic and arcade sports simulations, covering football, pool, basketball and management titles.
local_terms: CN: 体育 (tǐyù). KR: 스포츠 (seupocheu). JP: スポーツ (supōtsu).
subgenres: Realistic Sports, Arcade Sports, Sports Manager

name: Shooter
definition: Aim-and-fire combat, covering battle royale and first and third-person shooters.
local_terms: CN: 射击 (shèjī). JP: シューティング (shūtingu), abbreviated STG. The KR Play tree has no shooter category.
subgenres: Battle Royale, FPS/TPS

name: Racing
definition: Driving and racing games, mostly arcade-style on mobile.
local_terms: CN: 竞速 (jìngsù). KR: 자동차 경주 (jadongcha gyeongju) on Google Play, 레이싱 (reising) on the App Store. JP: レーシング (rēshingu).
subgenres: Arcade Racing

name: Action
definition: Real-time combat and reflex games outside the shooter and arcade buckets, covering hack-and-slash, action sandbox and shoot-'em-up.
local_terms: CN: 动作 (dòngzuò). KR: 액션 (aeksyeon). JP: アクション (akushon), abbreviated ACT.
subgenres: Shoot 'em Up, Hack and Slash, Action Sandbox

name: Geolocation
definition: Location-based games using real-world movement, GPS and AR.
subgenres: Geolocation

name: Adventure & narrative
definition: Story-led games where progress comes from exploration, dialogue and puzzle-solving rather than combat systems.
local_terms: CN: 冒险 (màoxiǎn). KR: 어드벤처 (eodeubencheo). JP: アドベンチャー (adobenchā), which names visual novels rather than Western adventure, see Visual novel.
subgenres: Point-and-click, Walking simulator, Narrative adventure, Interactive fiction

name: Survival & crafting
definition: Games built on resource gathering, base construction and persistent threat, usually in an open world with heavy loss on death.
local_terms: CN: 生存 (shēngcún).
subgenres: Open-world survival, Crafting, Extraction, Colony survival

name: Fighting
definition: One-on-one or small-team melee combat with per-character movesets, built around competitive skill expression.
local_terms: CN: 格斗 (gédòu).
subgenres: 2D fighter, 3D fighter, Platform fighter, Arena fighter

name: Platformer
definition: Movement-led games where traversal, jumping and level geometry are the core challenge.
subgenres: 2D platformer, 3D platformer, Metroidvania, Precision platformer

name: Horror
definition: Games organised around fear, dread and threat. Defined by tone rather than mechanic, which is what makes it unstable as a category.
local_terms: CN: 恐怖 (kǒngbù). JP: ホラー (horā).
subgenres: Survival horror, Psychological horror, Co-op horror, Analog horror

name: Roguelike & roguelite
definition: Run-based games with procedural generation and loss of progress on death, where some progress carries across runs in the roguelite variant.
local_terms: CN trees use the Latin terms Roguelike and Roguelite as-is. JP: ローグライク (rōguraiku) and ローグライト (rōguraito).
subgenres: Traditional roguelike, Roguelite, Roguelike deckbuilder, Action roguelike

name: Party & social deduction
definition: Short-session multiplayer games designed for groups, including hidden-role and social-deduction formats.
subgenres: Party, Social deduction, Minigame collection, Quiz

name: Visual novel
definition: Text-led games where the primary interaction is reading and branching choice, often with limited or no other mechanics.
local_terms: JP: アドベンチャー (adobenchā).
subgenres: Visual novel, Otome, Sound novel

name: Rhythm & music
definition: Games where input is timed to music, with a strong arcade and mobile presence in Japan and Korea.
local_terms: CN: 音游 (yīnyóu). KR: 음악 (eumak), the Music category. JP: 音ゲー (ongē), also リズムゲーム (rizumu gēmu).
subgenres: Rhythm action, Idol rhythm, Instrument, Arcade rhythm

name: MMO
definition: Persistent shared-world games supporting large simultaneous populations, usually subscription or item-shop monetised.
local_terms: CN trees use MMO as-is.
subgenres: MMORPG, MMO sandbox, Social world

name: Sandbox & UGC platform
definition: Platforms where most playable content is made by users rather than the operator. Function as storefronts and social spaces as much as games.
local_terms: CN: 沙盒 (shāhé).
subgenres: UGC platform, Creative sandbox, User-generated worlds

name: Simulation, vehicle and management
definition: High-fidelity simulation of vehicles, farming, industry and sports management, usually with long sessions and steep learning curves.
subgenres: Sim racing, Flight sim, Farming sim, Sports management, Colony sim

name: Educational & kids
definition: Games made for children and for learning contexts, distributed through store categories rather than vendor genre trees.
local_terms: KR: 교육 (gyoyuk). JP: 子ども向け (kodomo-muke) and ファミリー (famirī).
subgenres: Early learning, Kids entertainment, Classroom

name: Indie
definition: Not a genre at all. A production and funding descriptor, meaning a game made outside major-publisher structures, which vendor trees carry alongside genres as though it were one.
local_terms: CN: 独立游戏 (dúlì yóuxì). KR: 인디 (indi) on the App Store.
subgenres: No subgenres. The term describes who made a game rather than how it plays

name: Pinball
definition: Digital recreations of physical pinball tables, plus original tables built to the same physics conventions.
subgenres: Table simulation, Original tables, Licensed tables

name: Quiz and trivia
definition: Question-and-answer games scored on knowledge and speed, including live and asynchronous multiplayer formats.
local_terms: KR: 퀴즈 (kwijeu). JP: トリビア (toribia).
subgenres: Trivia, Quiz show, Live quiz, Pub quiz

name: Word
definition: Games built on vocabulary, spelling and letter manipulation, including crosswords, anagrams and guessing formats.
local_terms: KR: 단어 (daneo). JP: 単語 (tango).
subgenres: Crossword, Anagram, Word search, Guessing
